noNominations.title: Degmadaada doorashada ma jiraan musharraxiin ama xisbiyo ka jawaabay Hagaha Doorashada
noNominations.content: Waad eegi kartaa su'aalaha haddii aad rabto, laakiin natiijooyinka lama muujin karo.

someNominations.title: Musharraxiinta ama xisbiyada doorashooyinka qaar kama ay jawaabin Hagaha Doorashada
someNominations.content: Ma jiraan jawaabo musharraxiin ama xisbiyo oo la heli karo dhammaan doorashooyinka degmadaada doorashada. Natiijooyinku waxay kaliya muujin doonaan doorashooyinka jawaabahoodu la heli karo.
